nodes.description: Address of the contract owner; initialized to msg.sender in the constructor and enforced by the onlyOwner modifier across privileged functions.
Pending owner address written by transferOwnership and consumed by acceptOwnership during the two-step ownership handover.
Mapping holding the token balance of every account; mutated by transfer and transferFrom.
Nested mapping of owner to spender allowances; written by approve and approveAndCall, consumed by transferFrom.
Auxiliary address used as a transfer gate; set by transfernewun and checked by require statements in transfer and transferFrom.
Immutable-in-practice total supply assigned in the constructor and referenced by totalSupply().
Deployment-time initializer that sets the owner state variable from msg.sender.
onlyOwner function that stages a new owner into newOwner; no immediate privilege transfer.
Completes the two-step ownership transfer; requires msg.sender to equal newOwner, then rotates owner and clears newOwner.
onlyOwner setter that overwrites the newun transfer-gate address, able to freeze or redirect trading.
View function returning _totalSupply minus the balance burned at address(0).
View function returning balances[tokenOwner] for an arbitrary supplied address.
Transfers tokens from msg.sender to 'to' after a require gate against newun; updates balances and emits Transfer.
Sets allowed[msg.sender][spender] to tokens without any prior-allowance race protection.
Spends an allowance to move tokens; conditionally mutates the newun gate then debits balances and allowed before crediting the recipient.
View function returning allowed[tokenOwner][spender].
Sets an allowance and then makes an unbounded external call to the arbitrary spender's receiveApproval entry point before returning.
Payable fallback on the base token that unconditionally reverts, rejecting plain ETH transfers.
onlyOwner function that forwards the entire native balance of the contract to msg.sender via a low-level value transfer.
Empty payable fallback on the derived contract that silently accepts ETH, allowing the balance drained by clearCNDAO to accumulate.
Caller-controlled address used as owner initialization, allowance owner, balance owner, transfer recipient of contract funds and forwarded caller in external calls.
_owner.transfer(address(this).balance) sends the whole ETH balance to msg.sender; a value-bearing external interaction executed after the onlyOwner check.
ApproveAndCallFallBack(spender).receiveApproval(...) is an arbitrary external call to an attacker-supplied contract executed from approveAndCall.
Balance and allowance mutation arithmetic (sub/add on balances and allowed) performed with the SafeMath library.
Privilege check and ownership rotation logic comparing msg.sender against owner/newOwner inside onlyOwner and acceptOwnership.
Caller-supplied address staged into the newOwner state variable.
Caller-supplied address written into the newun transfer gate.
Recipient address of the transfer; compared against newun and credited.
Amount debited from msg.sender and credited to the recipient.
Address granted the allowance in the allowed mapping.
Allowance amount written for the spender.
Account whose balance and allowance are debited.
Recipient account credited and compared against newun.
Amount moved between balances and subtracted from the allowance.
Allowance beneficiary that is also invoked as an external contract before returning.
Allowance amount granted before the external callback.
Arbitrary calldata forwarded verbatim to the untrusted spender contract.
Address whose balance mapping entry is read.
Local payable alias of msg.sender used as the destination of the full contract balance transfer.

edges.reason: msg.sender is written directly into the owner state variable at construction, making deployer identity the root of all privilege.
transferOwnership is gated by the onlyOwner modifier, which compares msg.sender against owner; a mismatch reverts.
acceptOwnership requires msg.sender == newOwner before rotating the owner pointer, so caller identity decides the transfer outcome.
transfernewun is onlyOwner-gated; caller identity determines whether the newun transfer gate can be rewritten.
clearCNDAO is onlyOwner-gated and uses msg.sender as the fund recipient, conjoining the privilege check and the payout target.
msg.sender flows into the payable local destination of the full-balance native transfer in clearCNDAO.
msg.sender is forwarded as the 'from' argument into the untrusted spender contract during the receiveApproval external call.
msg.sender indexes the balances and allowed mappings whose entries are debited and credited by SafeMath operations.
The owner state variable is read by the onlyOwner modifier attached to transferOwnership.
The owner state variable is read by the onlyOwner modifier protecting the full-balance withdrawal function.
owner is the compared operand in the privilege guard, feeding the ownership guard operation.
newOwner is read, compared against msg.sender and then promoted to owner inside acceptOwnership.
The _newOwner parameter is assigned to the newOwner state variable, staging a privilege handover.
The _newun parameter is stored directly into the newun transfer gate state variable.
The 'to' parameter is compared against newun and used as the credit key in the balances mapping.
The tokens parameter is the amount subtracted from the sender and added to the recipient.
The spender parameter is the inner key of the allowed mapping entry written by approve.
The tokens parameter is the allowance value stored in the allowed mapping.
The from parameter selects the balances and allowed entries that are debited in transferFrom.
The to parameter is credited and also checked against newun inside transferFrom.
The tokens parameter is the amount moved and subtracted from the spender allowance.
The spender parameter receives an allowance and is then invoked as an external contract, becoming the callback target.
The tokens parameter is both the stored allowance and an argument of the external receiveApproval call.
The data parameter is forwarded unmodified to the untrusted external contract.
The tokenOwner parameter indexes the balances mapping returned by balanceOf.
The _owner local variable is derived from msg.sender and used as the transfer destination in clearCNDAO.
The _owner local variable is the receiver of the entire contract balance in the native transfer operation.
transfer performs checked sub/add arithmetic on the balances mapping entries via SafeMath.
transferFrom performs chained checked sub/add arithmetic on balances and allowed mappings.
transfer reads the newun state variable in its require gate, allowing the owner to block or redirect transfers.
transferFrom both reads and writes the newun state variable when the from address is the zero address.
transferFrom debits the allowed mapping entry of the from/msg.sender pair.
The owner state variable is initialized from msg.sender during construction.
approveAndCall unconditionally executes the external receiveApproval call on the attacker-controlled spender contract.
The untrusted spender contract regains control through receiveApproval and may re-enter approveAndCall or other token entry points before state settles.
A malicious receiveApproval implementation can re-enter transferFrom while the allowance and balance bookkeeping of the outer call is in flight.
clearCNDAO unconditionally reaches the native value transfer once the onlyOwner check passes.
The payable fallback of the derived contract allows ETH to accumulate in the contract balance that clearCNDAO later drains.
acceptOwnership enforces the msg.sender == newOwner comparison that constitutes the ownership guard.
The balances mapping can be read or mutated by a re-entrant call initiated through the external receiveApproval callback.
The derived payable fallback channels incoming ETH into the contract balance consumed by clearCNDAO.

normalization_plan.reason: The parameter exists solely as the source assigned into the newOwner state variable inside transferOwnership, so it must be folded into that core function node.
The parameter is written verbatim into the newun state variable inside the onlyOwner setter and has no independent meaning.
The recipient parameter is only meaningful within the transfer function's require gate and balance credit.
The amount parameter is only meaningful as the operand of the SafeMath debit and credit inside transfer.
The spender parameter is only used as the inner key of the allowed mapping entry written by approve.
The amount parameter is only used as the value stored in the allowed mapping inside approve.
The from parameter only selects the balances and allowed entries debited by transferFrom.
The to parameter only serves as the credit key and newun comparison inside transferFrom.
The amount parameter only drives the allowance and balance arithmetic inside transferFrom.
The spender parameter is both the allowance key and the target of the unsafe external receiveApproval call in approveAndCall.
The amount parameter only feeds the allowance write and the external call arguments inside approveAndCall.
The data blob is forwarded unchanged to the untrusted contract by approveAndCall and has no standalone semantics.
The address parameter only indexes the balances mapping read performed by balanceOf.
The local payable alias of msg.sender exists only to be the destination of the full-balance native transfer, so it folds into that unsafe operation.
